letter.subject: Concern regarding cookie and tracking practices on riotinto.com
letter.body:
Dear Data Protection Officer,

I am writing to raise concerns identified during an automated, passive privacy audit of https://riotinto.com on 2026-11-08 04:06 UTC. Using a fresh browser session, the audit visited the site, clicked the cookie banner option “Reject all”, then recorded what was still sent while browsing https://www.riotinto.com/en, https://www.riotinto.com/fr-CA/can/, and https://www.riotinto.com/ja-JP/jp/.

The following points arose:

1. Our review suggests Google tracking continued despite the site’s consent promise. Your privacy statement says: “適用法令により要求される場合、当社は、必須ではないCookieまたは類似技術を利用する前に、お客様の同意を求めます。” However, our review suggests Google received advertising and analytics-related requests before consent and continued receiving requests after the user clicked “Reject all”. This appears inconsistent with that statement.

2. We observed that Google still received data after cookies were rejected. After “Reject all” was clicked, there were 61 requests to google-analytics.com, googlesyndication.com, and googletagmanager.com. These requests were categorised as advertising-related in the audit.

3. We observed device fingerprinting activity from snitcher.com before any cookie choice was made. Scripts loaded from https://cdn.snitcher.com/releases/latest/radar.min.js used audio, canvas, and WebGL (GPU model) fingerprinting before the cookie banner had been answered.

In light of the above, please:

1. Explain each of the points above.
2. Confirm which cookies, trackers, or similar technologies you consider strictly necessary or otherwise exempt, and why.
3. Stop any non-essential tracking or similar technology operating without consent.
4. Reply within one month.

If this matter cannot be resolved, it may be raised with the Information Commissioner’s Office.

Yours faithfully,
Joshua Baker
